intel.title: [CISA KEV] GPUStack GPUStack - GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-102895
廠商: GPUStack
產品: GPUStack
漏洞名稱: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability
說明: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-12
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: This vulnerability affects an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: ; https://github.com/gpustack/gpustack/security/advisories/GHSA-gj9m-f8ph-pmhr ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-102895

analysis.summary: GPUStack 存在不當身份驗證漏洞（CVE-2026-102895），攻擊者可存取管理員權限並執行任意程式碼。該漏洞已被 CISA 納入已知被利用漏洞清單（KEV）中。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] OpenBSD OpenSSH - OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-123158

產品: OpenSSH
漏洞名稱: OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability
說明: OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-12
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown
reference_urls: This vulnerability affects an open-source component, third-party library, protocol, or proprietary implementation that could be used by different products. For more information, please see: https://www.openssh.org/releasenotes.html ; https://alpinelinux.org/posts/2026-11-05-openssh-password-authentication-bypass/ ; https://github.com/openssh/openssh-portable/commit/4353fdc43ef646c43a8dda7025cc1a898caf1482 ; BOD 26-04: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; Forensics Triage Requirements: https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/directives/bod-26-04-implementation-guidance-prioritizing-security-updates-based-risk ; https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-123158

analysis.summary: CISA KEV 釋出 OpenSSH on Linux 身份驗證繞過漏洞（CVE-2026-123158）之資安通報，攻擊者可利用此未預期狀態碼漏洞繞過驗證機制。該漏洞已有野外活躍攻擊紀錄，將直接威脅公司內部與雲端 Linux 伺服器之控制安全。
analysis.recommendation: 請系統管理團隊立即檢視並更新所有 Linux 伺服器（包含地端 Ubuntu Server 及 AWS EC2 實例）之 OpenSSH 套件至官方安全修補版本。若無法即時修補，請透過防火牆或 Security Group 嚴格限制 SSH 存取來源 IP，並持續監控異常登入行為。
affected_assets: 資訊軟體-伺服器軟體-Linux ubuntu
